## Details

### analog-rytm-mkii-research

RE workspace for Rytm MKII OS 1.72: a custom QEMU ColdFire machine, a desktop emulator that boots your OS file, tracing scripts, audio-path notes. Licence: unspecified; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### Chopshop

Browser builder for Rytm MK1/MKII OS 1.73 (CHOP with step locks, sample focus, per-track cuts) and Analog Keys OS 1.56 (chord memory, joystick random). Not OS 1.74, not Analog Four. Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later; distribution: browser-installer. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### libanalogrytm

C library that decodes and encodes Rytm SysEx (kits, sounds, patterns, settings, projects); no MIDI I/O. Dormant since 2023. Licence: MIT; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### rytm-builder

Assembles Rytm project SysEx from a library of pattern/kit dumps (Rust CLI and a Mac app); does not send MIDI. OS 1.70 object layout. Licence: MIT; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### rytm-fw-re

RE notes for Rytm MKII OS 1.74 (container, boot, display) and a tiny from-source replacement OS that boots on a unit, plus same-size splash and LED-palette patches. Recovery only over DIN MIDI. Licence: unspecified; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### rytm-mods-src

Public copy of MrScruff's Rytm MKII OS 1.73 mods 0000-0015 (euclid accents, velocity humanise, random LFO, kit A/B, slice loop, control-all and more). Licence: GPL-2.0-only; distribution: patch-your-own. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### rytm1_mods

Port of the rytm-mods to Rytm MK1 OS 1.73 (per-track cuts, random LFO, euclid accents, humanise); also emits elekloader .elemod files. Licence: unspecified; distribution: patch-your-own. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### analog-emu (rytm-emu)

Emulator for Analog Rytm, Analog Four/Keys and the Syntakt that boots your own OS file (Syntakt: main screen, digital tracks and modelled analog tracks sound), for testing mods. MIT. Found by GitHub search 2026-11-02; README start read.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### analoghealth

digihealth's SYSTEM INFO and REMOTE KEYS ported to the analog machines. GPL. Found by GitHub search 2026-11-02; README start read.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### rytm2_mods

MrScruff's Rytm MKII mods (published with permission) ported to the elemod format for elekloader core-ar2. GPL. Found by GitHub search 2026-11-02; README start read.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### analog-rytm-agent-bridge

MCP control plane with 32 tools so a coding agent can operate a Rytm MKII (patterns, kits, scenes, songs) with validated SysEx deltas. MIT. Found by GitHub search 2026-11-02; README start read.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_
